Name: Throwable Axe
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Throwable Axe[/b] lets you throw your axe at monsters to damage them.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Select an axe in your toolbar and right-click to throw it! Better axes go faster and do more damage. The axe will return automatically so you can do it again.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
